about: Rule decisions settled by hand, applied by the compiler's passes (no model calls): run FlareAI.GuideCompiler --passes after editing. 'rules': per rule id (permanent keys): 'use' replaces the Use cell ("" = flag only), 'remove' drops Avoid terms (with their own Use values), 'avoid'/'pattern'/'example'/'severity'/'why'/'text'/'bad'/'good' replace those cells, 'kind' turns a row into a pattern or prose (prose clears the lint cells), 'applies' replaces the Content tags and 'applies_add' adds some, 'page_scope': false drops the page's pack tag from the rule, 'drop': <owner id> removes the rule and hands its source units to the owner. 'pages': 'applies_add' for every rule of a page. 'add': rules the source states mechanically that the page compile left as prose (#64), each with its page, a permanent key and its source units. 'severity': the policy for lint rows (#61): error only for the rules listed under 'error'; flag-only rows (no safe fix) are suggestions unless listed under 'keep_warning'; rows listed under 'suggestion' are suggestions. Entries are rule ids or page prefixes ending in '/'. A severity set in 'rules' wins over the policy. 'checks'.'good_flagged_ok': Good examples that Google means to contain a flagged term (an old term in parentheses, a code keyword); the #62 check accepts exactly these rule/flagged-by pairs.
